name: Netlify
line: Static and frontend hosting with functions, forms and a managed Postgres.

free.text: 300 shared credits/month; no top-ups; team projects pause at zero

cells.regions: Functions: 12 regions; CDN edge is global

work.math: Assuming 20 successful production deploys: 300 + 2,000 (for 100 GB) + 200 (for 1 million requests) = 2,500 credits, within Pro's 3,000. The base is $20 or $25.
Assuming 20 successful deploys and 250 ms at 1,024 MB: 2,500 + 694.444 = 3,194.444 credits. That is one $10 pack over Pro's 3,000 credits, plus the $20 or $25 base.

Assuming the small app API + 2 database units for 730 hours, and all 10 GB of database traffic going out: 17,994.444 credits. Pro ($20 or $25) + 10 packs ($100) leaves 5.56 credits. Storage and backup rates are unknown.
